camel_example: aliyun polardb ModifyAccountDescriptionZonal --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription testdes --DBClusterId 'pc-*************' --AccountName testacc
description_en: Modifies the description of a PolarDB on ENS account
description_zh: 修改PolarDB边缘云账号的描述
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-account-description-zonal --db-cluster-id 'pc-*************' --account-name testacc --account-description testdes --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAccountDescriptionZonal

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. This operation is applicable only to PolarDB on ENS. You must use the ID of an edge cluster. You can call the DescribeDBClustersZonal operation and obtain the DBClusterId from the Items list in the response. Regular PolarDB cluster IDs are not accepted
parameters.help_zh: 集群 ID。本接口仅适用于 PolarDB 边缘集群，必须使用边缘集群 ID；可调用 DescribeDBClustersZonal，从返回的 Items 列表中获取 DBClusterId。常规 PolarDB 集群 ID 不被接受
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the account. The description must meet the following requirements:
It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
账号备注信息，备注信息需满足如下要求：
不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
